page.overview:
Who is Kurt Nelson?

Kurt Nelson was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

He was a flag officer with the rank of admiral in 2364. Early that year, as a Starfleet Tactical Command officer, he sent a mission order about the Kandari sector com mode to Captain Bryan D. Furen of the . (, okudagram)
